name: Water

sections.body: Colonists have a major water need implemented by Need_Water. It initializes at 90% and falls 0.7 per day before environment and retention. NeedInterval is 150 ticks (400 intervals per day). The thirsty threshold is 0.3; desperate is 0.15. The dehydration hediff starts below 0.3 need and is lethal at severity 1.
sections.title: Water need

sections.body: Need_Water.EnvironmentMultiplier scales thirst by ambient temperature (1.0 default; 1.15 from 20C; 1.55 from 32C; 2.1 from 42C; 0.8 below 0C) and multiplies by 1.12 when unroofed.
sections.title: Heat and exposure

sections.body: Worn SoA apparel adds SoA_WaterRetention. At normal quality and full condition: stillsuit 60%, reclamation mask 30%, stillsuit headwrap 15%. Quality and remaining HP scale only that piece. The stack is clamped to 0.999. A stillsuit plus mask at normal quality is 90% retention, never immunity.
sections.title: Water retention

sections.body: Windtraps and personal condensers use CompProperties_WaterProducer. Base clock is productionTicks/outputCount; environment efficiency can zero a sealed intake. Cisterns store SoA_Water category items without producing water. Dew bladder wild plants can harvest exactly one water ration.
sections.title: Collectors and storage

summary: Water is a dedicated survival need on Arrakis. Heat, exposure, stillsuit seals, and moisture collectors determine how long a pawn lasts between rations.
